units.source_text: 诸人通宵歌舞，直到天明。

en.t: Everyone sang and danced through the night until dawn.

units.source_text: 二十日的月亮清光普照，海面一白无际。

en.t: The moon of the twentieth night spread its clear light everywhere, and the sea was white as far as the eye could see.

units.source_text: 霜华甚重，松原变成了白色。

en.t: The frost lay very thick, and the pine grove had turned white.

units.source_text: 眺望一切景物，但觉寒气彻骨，平添了优美与岑寂之感。

en.t: Looking out over all the scenery, one felt only a bone-piercing cold, which added a sense of beauty and deep stillness.
